name: flutterwave_tampered_body_still_authenticates
description: THE IMPORTANT ONE. Flutterwave's verif-hash is a static shared secret, not an HMAC over the body, so this forged amount authenticates exactly as well as the honest one. signature_valid is true and the reported amount is the attacker's. This is why the webhook handler must call verify() independently and treat the payload as a notification rather than as evidence.
